customlocatorcolor.config.title: Custom Locator Color
customlocatorcolor.config.description: Give any player their own color on the locator bar. Player names are not case sensitive. Tip: press the hotkey (default X, changeable in Controls) to open this screen anytime in-game.
customlocatorcolor.config.enabled.toolti: Turn this off to show all locators in their normal colors without deleting your list.
customlocatorcolor.config.players.toolti: Click the + button to add a player. New entries appear at the top.
customlocatorcolor.config.player.name: Player name
customlocatorcolor.config.player.name.to: The exact in-game username (case does not matter).
customlocatorcolor.config.player.color.t: Click the color box to pick a color, or type a hex code like #FF0000.
